products.geographic_scope: Destinations/countries/regions selected on the Certificate of Insurance; cover only applies within the listed destination(s)/region(s). Transit/stop-over <24 hours does not need to be listed.
products.eligibility_rules: Eligible if you have a permanent home in Australia and are either an Australian permanent resident, or hold a current Australian visa (not tourist/working holiday) allowing unrestricted re-entry after your journey, or hold a valid Australian Medicare card; policy must be purchased before starting your journey; journey must start and end in Australia.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Comprehensive, Domestic and Non‑Medical Plans available to travellers of all ages. Basic and Multi‑Trip available only if aged under 75 at time of issue.
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Cooling‑off: full refund within 14 days if you haven’t started your journey, made a claim or exercised any right. After cooling‑off: partial pro‑rata refund if you haven’t started your journey and no claim/rights exercised. COVID‑19 border closure/quarantine: full refund if no journey commenced; partial pro‑rata refund if journey commenced or for Multi‑Trip per stated rules; no refund where a claim is or will be made.
products.excess_options: A base excess applies per event; amount shown on Certificate of Insurance. You may vary the base excess at purchase (pay more for lower excess or reduce premium for higher excess). Additional non‑removable $500 excess applies to claims under 1.2 Medical and 2.1 Cancellation arising from Adventure Pack or Snow Pack activities.

excess_rules.amount: Base excess (selected amount shown on COI) per event

excess_rules.benefit: 1.1 Overseas Emergency Assistance; 1.3 Funeral Expenses; 1.6 Hospital Cash Allowance; 3.2 Travel Delay; 4.2 Luggage Delay; 4.4 Theft of Cash; 7.3 Cabin Confinement; 7.6 Formal Wear Delay; 7.7 Marine Rescue Diversion; 7.12 Piste Closure
1.2 Overseas Medical & Hospital Expenses; 2.1 Cancellation (when claim relates to Adventure Pack or Snow Pack activities)
excess_rules.amount: Additional non‑removable $500 (replaces base excess amount for those claims)

products.additional_expenses_or_trip_disruption_l: $50,000 (Pre‑existing medical condition of a relative sub‑limit $2,000)
products.travel_delay_limit: $3,000 ($300 after initial 6‑hour delay, then again each consecutive 24 hours)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: $750 general; $3,000 computers/tablets/cameras/video cameras; $1,000 mobile phones; items left in a concealed locked vehicle by day $200 per item, $2,000 total
products.personal_accident_limit: $50,000 (death or permanent disability per person; Family $50,000 per person/$100,000 per policy)
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID‑19 is covered under medical/assistance, funeral, hospital cash, cancellation and additional expenses when the plan includes those benefits; no cover for government border closures except premium refund rules; other COVID‑related events not listed are excluded.

cruise_benefits.excess: Base excess; dental >2 weeks requires approval
cruise_benefits.conditions: Only if Cruise Pack purchased; includes dental due to injury or sudden pain
Approval by Allianz Global Assistance required for evacuation/funeral/return of remains

optional_add_ons.name: Adventure Pack
optional_add_ons.availability: Available for Comprehensive, Multi‑Trip and Domestic if aged under 75
optional_add_ons.effects: Adds cover for listed adventure activities; adds non‑removable $500 excess to 1.2 Medical and 2.1 Cancellation claims arising from these activities; no cover under 1.5 Permanent Disability or 6.1 Personal Liability for these activities

optional_add_ons.name: Cruise Pack
optional_add_ons.availability: Available for Comprehensive, Multi‑Trip and Domestic
optional_add_ons.effects: Adds cruise‑specific medical, evacuation, cabin confinement, shore excursion cancellation, formal wear cover and marine rescue diversion benefits

optional_add_ons.name: Snow Pack
optional_add_ons.availability: Available for Comprehensive, Multi‑Trip and Domestic if aged under 75
optional_add_ons.effects: Adds snow sport medical/assistance (overseas only), equipment, hire, pack, piste closure and bad weather/avalanche covers; adds non‑removable $500 excess to 1.2 Medical and 2.1 Cancellation for snow sport claims; no cover under 1.5 Permanent Disability or 6.1 Personal Liability for snow sports

optional_add_ons.name: Increased Item Limits Cover
optional_add_ons.availability: Available for Comprehensive, Multi‑Trip, Domestic and Non‑Medical (not available on Basic)
optional_add_ons.effects: Increases item limits under 4.1 up to $7,000 Single/$7,000 per person Duo/$14,000 Family; standard item limits/depreciation do not apply to purchased item types; vehicle storage limits still apply

optional_add_ons.name: Vary the Base Excess
optional_add_ons.availability: Available on any plan at purchase
optional_add_ons.effects: Pay higher premium to lower excess or reduce premium by increasing excess; base excess shown on COI

sub_limits.name: Travel agents’ cancellation fees
sub_limits.amount: $1,500 (Duo: $1,500 per person up to $3,000; Family up to $3,000)

sub_limits.name: Pre‑existing medical condition of a relative (death/admission in AU/NZ)

products.limit_basis_notes: For Single and Family cover types, maximum limits apply to all claims combined under each benefit (Family shared unless per‑person noted). Duo limits apply per person except Cancellation which is per policy. Limits/sub‑limits as per Table of Benefits.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: No cover for any pre‑existing medical condition unless disclosed and Allianz Global Assistance agrees in writing; details shown on Certificate of Insurance/Medical Terms of Cover. Cannot apply for cover if signs/symptoms are undiagnosed/under investigation. Basic and Non‑Medical Plans cannot include cover for pre‑existing conditions.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: If pregnant at purchase and you have complications or a multiple pregnancy, you must apply for cover. Otherwise, automatic cover for unforeseen events up to before 24 weeks’ gestation. Never covered: pregnancy at 24+ weeks, routine antenatal care, childbirth or newborn care (unless an accident before 24 weeks causes premature birth or requires admission beyond 24 weeks during which birth occurs).
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Relative events limited to relatives residing in Australia or New Zealand; where death/admission due to relative’s pre‑existing medical condition, sub‑limit applies ($2,000 Single; $2,000 per person Duo up to $4,000; $4,000 Family) and only if you were unaware of likelihood at policy issue.

optional_activity_cover.conditions: Driver must hold appropriate licence (not learner) for vehicle in Australia or in the country of travel; pillion allowed if driver licensed; quad bike driver only (no pillion); appropriate helmet required; no racing or professional use; Adventure Pack purchase required.

optional_activity_cover.activity_or_pack: Diving using artificial breathing apparatus to >10m and ≤30m (Adventure Pack)
optional_activity_cover.conditions: Must hold an open water licence recognised in Australia or dive with a licensed instructor; restrictions apply incl. no diving alone.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers the amount you are liable to pay under the rental agreement if the rental vehicle is damaged/stolen, up to $6,000. You must be a nominated driver and rent from a licensed company/agency. Excludes breach of rental agreement, unlicensed/unauthorised drivers, depreciation/administration/loss of use and items beyond the stated liability (e.g., tyres, rims, glass, roof/underbody if outside the agreement).
products.luggage_conditions: No cover for valuables left in a vehicle at any time or checked in to cargo holds. Luggage left in a vehicle only covered in daylight if hidden in a concealed locked compartment and forced entry evidenced (sub‑limit $200 item/$2,000 total). Must take reasonable precautions; report loss/theft to police/carrier; proof of ownership/value and depreciation apply except for items <12 months old.

general_exclusions.details: No cover for activities not in Included Activities unless Adventure/Snow Pack purchased as applicable; no cover for cruising unless Cruise Pack purchased; various racing/time trial/professional sports excluded.
No cover unless pregnancy automatic criteria met or AGA agrees in writing to include cover; Basic and Non‑Medical cannot obtain PEC cover.
No cover at/after 24 weeks, routine antenatal care, childbirth or newborn care (except specific accident‑related scenarios before 24 weeks).
General exclusion unless covered events expressly included in specified sections (medical/assistance, funeral, hospital cash, cancellation, additional expenses, and certain optional pack benefits).
No cover for financial collapse/insolvency or misappropriation by service providers.

benefit_exclusions.exclusion: No cover for claims arising from Adventure Pack activities or snow sport activities (even if packs purchased).
No cover for snow sport or cruise scenarios under these base benefits; must rely on Snow Pack 7.8 or Cruise Pack 7.2 respectively.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover if travelling contrary to Smartraveller 'Do not travel' advice or not acting to minimise/avoid potential claim. Sanctions clause: no cover/benefit/refund if doing so breaches UN/US/AU/EU/UK/NZ sanctions or laws.
products.claims_process_summary: Notify Allianz Global Assistance as soon as reasonably aware. Submit online via www.claimmanager.com.au or by email/post. Provide supporting documents (police/carrier reports, medical reports, receipts, proof of ownership). Emergency approval recommended before incurring significant medical expenses; AGA aims to consider claims within 10 business days after receiving complete information.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24‑hour Emergency Assistance: +61 7 3305 7499 (overseas), 1800 010 075 (within Australia). Contact AGA as soon as practicable if admitted to hospital or for outpatient treatment likely to exceed $2,000; approvals will not be unreasonably withheld/delayed.
products.premium_factors: Destination(s), journey length, amount/type of cover, number/ages of travellers, timing of purchase versus start date, pre‑existing medical conditions, likelihood of a claim, commissions/discounts/government charges, chosen excess, and optional add‑ons.
